intro: Our Alps recliner is all about comfort. With adjustable headrest, recliner and a USB charger, it’s the perfect spot to lounge, relax, stay powered and enjoy every moment of yours in style

features.title: Touch recline that listens to you
features.text: Power-controlled touch panel on the inner armrest lets you glide to your perfect angle in seconds, from upright to fully relaxed, without shuffling cushions or losing the moment you’re in.

features.title: Headrest and footrest move independently
features.text: Dual motors let the headrest and recliner at both ends work on their own, so you can watch, read, or nap with support tuned to you rather than one fixed position for everyone.

features.title: Zero-wall design frees up your room
features.text: Forward-moving mechanism reclines without touching the wall, opening full stretch even in tighter layouts, so you save precious space and still get the deep, unhurried comfort you crave.

features.title: High back and enhanced lumbar support
features.text: A tall back that gently cradles and added lumbar support help your spine relax, easing the day’s weight so shoulders drop and breathing slows while you settle into calm.

features.title: Smooth, quiet motion you hardly hear
features.text: A stable, noiseless mechanism moves softly under you, so late-night reclines and early-morning resets feel serene, without clicks or scrapes breaking the quiet.

features.title: USB A and C keep you charged
features.text: Built-in USB A and USB C ports keep your phone and earbuds powered from the seat, so playlists, calls, and shows continue without hunting for chargers or trailing cables.

name: Alps Motorised L Shape Fabric Recliner
